## Load data (Luminex, Olink and sample information):

```{r}
serology_norm <- read.csv("BAMSE_serology_log2_bb_igm_normalized_data.csv")

samp_info_key <- read.csv("./datafiles/sample_information/bamse_sampleid_key_v2.csv")
sample_info_key <- samp_info_key

cluster_5prot_info <- ("cluster_information_bamse_subjects_hierarchical5protein_maximumdist.csv")

empty_disc_list <- read_excel("empty_disc_list.xlsx")

olink_bamse_protpqn_blank_rm_intnorm <- read.csv("protPQN intensity normalized bamse data_241004.csv")


## Sample information:
sample_info <- read.csv("normalized serology data with sample information_bamse samples_240627.csv")
sample_info <- sample_info[,c(2:38,110:122) ]

# Wide sample info:
sample_info_wide <- read.csv("BAMSE C19 2023-03-06_v2.csv")

## Updated sampling dates:
sampling_date_updated <- read.csv("./sample_data/Datum_Filterpapper_korrigerad_250227.csv")

### Cell count data:
bc_data <- read_excel("BAMSE_C19_Blodstatus.xlsx")
bc_data <- bc_data %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_replace_all(., "(?<!\\d)\\.(\\d)", "0.\\1")))

bc_data <- bc_data %>%
  mutate(across(c(basgran_c19, eosgran_c19, erytrocyt_c19, evf_c19, leukocyt_c19, lymfocyt_c19,  monocyt_c19, neutgran_c19 ), as.numeric))


## Remove the samples with empty discs from the serology data:
empty_disc_samp <- empty_disc_list |>
  filter(No_blood == 1) |>
  pull(sample_name...8). # Containt the sample names

serology_norm_rm_empty <- serology_norm |>
  rename(sample_name = X) |>
  filter(!sample_name %in% empty_disc_samp)

## Combine data with sample information:
serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo <- serology_norm_rm_empty |>
  left_join(sample_info, by = "sample_name") |>
  mutate(sampling_phase = plot_variable) # Change name of plot_variable to sampling_phase to make it more clear

serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo <- serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo %>%
  left_join(sample_info_wide[ , c("idnr", "sminet_date", "IgG_bamse")], by = "idnr") |>
  mutate(
    sample_date = as.Date(sample_date),
    sminet_date = as.Date(sminet_date)
  ) |>
  mutate(time_diff = ifelse(sminet_date < sample_date, sample_date - sminet_date, NA))

beads_of_interest <- colnames(serology_norm_rm_empty)[c(2:73)]
covid_beads <- beads_of_interest_short[-grep("ifn|bare|anti|ebna|rabbit|^RBD$", beads_of_interest_short)]
```

### For review: Antibody signals in the different phases, just light grey lines for each subject, and then a trendline (loess smooth) for the overall pattern:

```{r}

## Using Z-scores:
plots_zscore <- lapply(covid_beads, function(bead) {
  ggplot(serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo, aes(x = sampling_phase, y = scale(.data[[bead]], scale= TRUE, center = TRUE))) +
    geom_line(aes(group = idnr), color = "lightgrey", alpha = 0.3) + 
    labs(title = paste0(bead), x = "Sampling phase") +
    theme_classic() +
    ylab(paste0("Z-score.", bead)) + 
    guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
    geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "black", formula = 'y ~ x')
})

# Transform data to be relative to Phase 1 per individual
serology_relative <- serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo %>%
  group_by(idnr) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(covid_beads), function(x) {
    # Extract the value at Phase 1 for a specific person
    baseline <- x[sampling_phase == "Phase 1"]
    
    # If they are missing Phase 1, or have multiple records, fallback to NA
    if (length(baseline) != 1) {
      return(NA_real_) 
    }
    
    # Otherwise: perform the subtraction
    return(x - baseline)
  })) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Clean up individuals who couldn't be normalized (missing Phase 1)
  filter(!is.na(.data[[covid_beads[1]]]))

plots_relative <- lapply(covid_beads, function(bead) {
  ggplot(serology_relative, aes(x = sampling_phase, y = .data[[bead]])) +
    geom_line(aes(group = idnr), color = "lightgrey", alpha = 0.3) + 
    # Horizontal reference line at 0 to emphasize no-change
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = paste0(bead), x = "Sampling phase") +
    theme_classic() +
    ylab(paste0("Relative change to Phase 1")) + 
    guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
    # Trendline showing population average change over time
    geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "black", formula = 'y ~ x')
})

```

### Sampling time plots in relation to vaccination (Figure 1b):

```{r}

sample_info_extended <- sample_info |>  left_join(sample_info_wide %>% select(idnr, chc19aldy, qc19_3aldy, IgG_bamse, male, smoke_c19_3, BMI_c19, qc19_3q9_1_yes, qc19_3q9_2_yes, c19_3_postcovid_symp, sminet_date  ), by = c("idnr_pad" = "idnr"))

serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo <- serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo |>
  left_join(sample_info_wide %>% select(idnr, chc19aldy, qc19_3aldy, IgG_bamse, male, smoke_c19_3, BMI_c19, qc19_3q9_1_yes, qc19_3q9_2_yes, c19_3_postcovid_symp, sminet_date  ), by = c("idnr_pad" = "idnr"))

ggplot( serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo, aes( x = as.Date(sampling_time), fill = sampling_phase)) +
  geom_histogram( col = "white") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Sampling date",
    y = "Number of Samples",
    fill = "Sampling Phase",
    title = "Number of samples per date"
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")

long_dates <- serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo |>
  mutate( sampling_time = as.Date(sampling_time),
          dose1 = as.Date(date1),
          dose2 = as.Date(date2),
          dose3 = as.Date(date3),
          sminet_date = as.Date(sminet_date),
          
          
          dose1 = if_else(dose1 <= sampling_time, dose1, as.Date(NA)),
          dose2 = if_else(dose2 <= sampling_time, dose2, as.Date(NA)),
          dose3 = if_else(dose3 <= sampling_time, dose3, as.Date(NA)),
          sminet_date = if_else(sminet_date <= sampling_time, sminet_date, as.Date(NA))
          
  ) |>
  select(sample_name, sampling_time, sampling_phase, dose1, dose2, dose3, sminet_date) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(sampling_time, dose1, dose2, dose3, sminet_date),
    names_to = "date_type",
    values_to = "date"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date)
  )

### Color the phases differentyly:
plot_data <- long_dates |>
  filter(date_type != "sminet_date") |>
  mutate(
    date_type = as.character(date_type),
    fill_group = if_else(
      date_type == "sampling_time",
      sampling_phase,
      date_type
    )
  )

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = date, fill = fill_group)) +
  geom_histogram(
    col = "white",
    alpha = 0.8,
    position = "stack",
    binwidth = 20
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ factor(date_type, levels = c("sampling_time", "dose1", "dose2", "dose3")),
    ncol = 1,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Phase 1" = "#66C2A5",
      "Phase 2" = "#FC8D62",
      "Phase 3" = "#8DA0CB",
      "dose1" = "#aed6f1",
      "dose2" = "#93c47d",
      "dose3" = "#004953"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "2 month",
    date_labels = "%Y-%m"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of samples across different dates",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of samples",
    fill = ""
  )

```

### Age distribution per sex (Fig. 1c):

```{r}
# Load age from phase 1:
age_bamse_df <- read.csv("bamse_age_all_phases.csv")

plot_data <- serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo |>
  select(idnr, male, sampling_phase) |>
  filter( sampling_phase == "Phase 1") |>
  left_join(age_bamse_df, by = "idnr") |>
  distinct(idnr, .keep_all = TRUE) |>  # Keep only unique idnr
  mutate(sex = case_when( 
    male == "1" ~ "Male",
    male == "0" ~ "Female"
  ))

mean_value <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarize(mean = mean(qc19_1aldy))

median_value <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarize(median = median(qc19_1aldy))

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = qc19_1aldy, col = sex)) +
  geom_density(size = 2) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "Density", title = "Age (Phase 1) distribution by sex", subtitle = "median = dotted, mean = dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Male" = "#697", "Female" = "#eac14a")) +
  geom_vline(data = mean_value, aes(xintercept = mean, color = sex), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(data = median_value, aes(xintercept = median, color = sex), linetype = "dotted") 
```

### Distribution of vaccination doses per sampling phase (Figure 1d):

```{r}
date_matrix <- serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo |>
  mutate( dose1 = as.Date(date1),
          dose2 = as.Date(date2),
          dose3 = as.Date(date3),
          sminet_date = as.Date(sminet_date)) |>
  select(sample_name, sampling_time, sampling_phase, dose1, dose2, dose3, sminet_date)


# Categorize samples based on the number of doses at sampling_time

  mutate(
    dose_count = case_when(
      is.na(dose1) & is.na(dose2) & is.na(dose3) ~ "0 doses",  # No doses at all
      sampling_time < dose1 ~ "0 doses",  
      sampling_time >= dose1 & (sampling_time < dose2 | is.na(dose2)) ~ "1 dose",  
      sampling_time >= dose2 & (sampling_time < dose3 | is.na(dose3)) ~ "2 doses",  
      sampling_time >= dose3 ~ "3 doses",  
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

  "1 dose" = "#aed6f1",   # Blue
  "2 doses" = "#93c47d",  # Green
  "3 doses" =  "#004953"   # Purple
)) )
```

# Serology analysis code:

### Hierarchical clustering of samples based on antibody response (Figure 2a):

```{r}
library(fpc)

# Define cluster characteristics:
clust_dist <- "maximum"
clust_method <- "ward.D2"
n_clust <- 4


six_prot_beads <- c("nucleocapsid.full", "nucleocapsid.c", "spike.s1" ,"spike.wt", "ba.2.rbd.omicron", "rbd.wt.sars.2")


## Take out only normalized mfi data:
clust_data <- serology_norm_rm_empty %>%
  select(!grep("_0.4", colnames(serology_norm_rm_empty))) |>
  select( all_of(six_prot_beads))


clust_stab <- T
# Perform stability test
if (clust_stab) {
  boot_clustfun <- function(x, dist_method = clust_dist, cl_method = clust_method, n_cl = n_clust) {
    # x, matrix with data to cluster
    
    clust_results <- dist(x, method = dist_method) %>% hclust(method = cl_method)
    clusts <- cutree(clust_results, n_cl)
    
    out_list <- list("result" = clust_results,
                     "nc" = length(unique(clusts)),
                     "clusterlist" = lapply(sort(unique(clusts)), function(x) {clusts == x}),
                     "partition" = clusts,
                     "clustermethod" = "hclust")
  }
  set.seed(123)
  bs <- clusterboot(clust_data, B = 100, clustermethod = boot_clustfun, count = F)
  #Jacard index - the size of the intersection divided by the size of the union of two label sets, is used to compare set of predicted labels for a sample to the corresponding set of labels in y_true:
  cat("Mean Jaccard indices: ")
  cat(bs$bootmean)
  
  # Get results from first run as clustering to look at
  hcl <- bs$result$result
} else {
  hcl <- clust_data %>% dist(method = clust_dist) %>% hclust(method = clust_method)
}

clusterSamples <- cutree(hcl, k = n_clust)
serology_norm_rm_empty$cluster_maximum_6prot_omi <- as.character(clusterSamples)

### Plot the heatmaps
library(ghibli)
library(pheatmap)
library(viridis)
```

### Determine seropositivity using population density cutoffs

Population-based threshold of 6 standard deviations (SD) of the estimated negative proportion above the Gaussian population peak. The negative population consisted of unvaccinated individuals without PCR-confirmed infection in sampling phase 1 & 2.

```{r}
dens_cl <- function(x, s, neg_prop, fullx_phase, method) {
  
  # Exclude controls and pools
  x_pop <- x
  
  # Save a cutoff, population density peak, and plot per protein
  cutoff_vec = peak_vec <- vector("numeric", ncol(x_pop))
  names(cutoff_vec) = names(peak_vec) <- colnames(x_pop)[1:(ncol(x_pop))]
  
  plt_lst <- vector("list", ncol(x_pop))
  names(plt_lst) <- colnames(x_pop)[1:(ncol(x_pop))]
  
  plt_lst2 <- vector("list", ncol(fullx_phase))
  names(plt_lst2) <- colnames(fullx_phase)[1:(ncol(fullx_phase))]
  
  for (prot in colnames(x_pop)[1:(ncol(x_pop))]) {
    val <- x_pop[, prot]
    
    # Get population density peak and distance from peak
    dens <- density(val)
    peak <- dens$x[which.max(dens$y)]
    pdist <- abs(val - peak)
    
    # Get variation of neg_prop around peak
    qtl <- quantile(pdist, probs = neg_prop)
    vtn <- sd(val[pdist <= qtl])
    
    # Classify points
    # Use a cutoff of peak - 6 for selected binders (due to high prevalence instead of low)
    cutoff <- peak + ifelse(grepl("anti.human|ebna", prot, ignore.case = T), -6, 6) * vtn
    
    peak_vec[prot] <- peak
    cutoff_vec[prot] <- cutoff
    
    # Make plot
    p <- ggplot(x_pop %>% dplyr::select(!!prot)) +
      geom_histogram(aes_string(x = prot), size = 1.2, fill = "white", col = "grey30") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = peak, linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff, linetype = "dotted") +
      labs( title = "Phase 1 and 2",
            subtitle = method) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(axis.line = element_line(size = 1),
            axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
            axis.title = element_text(size = 16))
    
    plt_lst[[prot]] <- p
    
    # Make plot on all sample phases:
    p <- ggplot(fullx_phase %>% dplyr::select(!!prot)) +
      geom_histogram(aes_string(x = prot), size = 1.2, fill = "white", col = "grey30") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = peak, linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff, linetype = "dotted") +
      labs( title = "All phases",
            subtitle = method) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(axis.line = element_line(size = 1),
            axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
            axis.title = element_text(size = 16))
    
    plt_lst2[[prot]] <- p
    
    
  }
  
  return(list("cutoffs" = cutoff_vec,
              "peaks" = peak_vec,
              "plots_cutoffs" = plt_lst,
              "plots_all_phases" = plt_lst2))
}

# Estimated proportion of positive samples from vaccinations and infections in phase 1 and 2:
serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo <- serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo |>
  mutate( cov_status = case_when( is.na(sminet_case) & is.na(vaccdose1) ~ "V-I-",
                                   is.na(sminet_case) & vaccdose1 == "Yes" ~ "V+I-",
                                   sminet_case=="Yes" & is.na(vaccdose1) ~ "V-I+",
                                   sminet_case=="Yes" & vaccdose1 == "Yes" ~ "V+I-",
                                   ))


filtered_data <- serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo |> 
  filter( sampling_phase %in% c("Phase 1", "Phase 2"))

# Calculate the number of rows matching cov_status conditions
matching_rows <- filtered_data |> 
  filter(cov_status %in% c("V-I+", "V+I-", "V+I+") | IgG_bamse == 1 ) |> 
  nrow()
# Calculate the total number of rows in the filtered dataset
total_rows <- nrow(filtered_data)
# Calculate the proportion
pos_prop <- matching_rows / total_rows

# Make cutoffs for each covid19 protein, INF protein and EBNA1
binfo <- data.frame(beads_of_interest)
colnames(binfo)[1] <- "analyte"
binfo$analyte_number <- 1:72

prot_incl <- binfo[-grep("bare|rabbit", binfo$analyte), 2]
mfi <- filtered_data[,c(2:73)]
sinfo <- filtered_data[,74:ncol(filtered_data)]

method <- "Density peak for P1&2 + 6SD(estimated neg)"
dens_cutoffs <- dens_cl(mfi[, c(prot_incl)], sinfo, 1 - pos_prop, serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo[,c(2:73)], method)


# Classify all samples (including controls) for each protein
cls <- serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo[, c("sample_name", names(dens_cutoffs$cutoffs))]
for (i in colnames(cls)[-1]) {
  cls[, i] <- cls[, i] > dens_cutoffs$cutoffs[i]
}

#      Create a summary table with % of TRUE/FALSE for each antibody:

# Reshape the data from wide to long format
long_cls <- cls |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -sample_name,   # Exclude the first column (sample_name)
    names_to = "protein",  # Create a 'protein' column with the protein names
    values_to = "value"    # Create a 'value' column with the corresponding TRUE/FALSE values
  )

# Calculate the percentage of TRUE and FALSE per protein
seropos_summary_table <- long_cls |>
  #group_by(protein) |>
  #mutate(total_count = n() ) |>
  #ungroup() |>
  group_by(protein, value) |>               # Group by protein and value (TRUE/FALSE)
  summarise(count = n()) |> # Count the number of TRUE and FALSE values per protein
  mutate(percentage = count / sum(count) * 100)

# Calculate the percentage of TRUE and FALSE per protein and phase
seropos_summary_table_phase <- long_cls |>
  left_join(serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo |> select( c("sample_name", "sampling_phase")), by = "sample_name") |>
  group_by(sampling_phase, protein, value) |>   # Group by protein and value (TRUE/FALSE)
  summarise(count = n()) |> # Count the number of TRUE and FALSE values per protein
  mutate(percentage = count / sum(count) * 100)
```

### Check how many are considered sero +/- per serocluster:

```{r}

# Create a summary table with % TRUE/FALSE per cluster:

# Initialize an empty list to store the small tables
seropos_cluster_comp <- list()

# Use lapply to create a list of tables, one for each protein
seropos_cluster_comp <- lapply(unique(seropos_summary_table$protein), function(prot) {
  
  # Filter the data for the current protein
  protein_data <- long_cls |>
    left_join(serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo[, c("sample_name", "sampling_phase", "IgG_bamse", "cluster_maximum_6prot_omi")]) |>
    filter(protein == prot)
  
  # Create a contingency table
  contingency_table <- table(protein_data$cluster_maximum_6prot_omi, protein_data$value)
  
  # Convert to data frame for easier manipulation
  df <- as.data.frame.matrix(contingency_table)
  
  
  return(df)
})

# Assign names to the list elements based on the protein names
names(seropos_cluster_comp) <- unique(seropos_summary_table$protein)

### Write it as a table:
seropositive_clusters_df <- map_dfr(covid_proteins, function(name) {
  # Extract the table for the current protein
  tbl <- seropos_cluster_comp[[name]] %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    rownames_to_column(var = "Serocluster") # Convert row names to a column
  
  # Ensure both "FALSE" and "TRUE" columns exist, replacing missing ones with 0
  if (!"FALSE" %in% colnames(tbl)) {
    tbl$`FALSE` <- 0
  }
  if (!"TRUE" %in% colnames(tbl)) {
    tbl$`TRUE` <- 0
  }
  
  # Create a data frame with required columns
  tbl %>%
    mutate(
      analyte = name, # Add analyte column
      percent_true = round(`TRUE` / (`FALSE` + `TRUE`) * 100, 1) # Calculate percentage
    ) %>%
    select(analyte, Serocluster, `FALSE`, `TRUE`, percent_true) # Reorder columns
})



### Seroclusters per phase:
# Initialize an empty list to store the small tables
seropos_cluster_comp_perphase <- list()

# Use lapply to create a list of tables, one for each protein
seropos_cluster_comp_perphase <- lapply(unique(covid_proteins), function(prot) {
  
  # Filter the data for the current protein
  protein_data <- long_cls |>
    left_join(serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo[, c("sample_name", "sampling_phase", "IgG_bamse", "cluster_maximum_6prot_omi")], by = "sample_name") |>
    filter(protein == prot)
  
  # Create a contingency table for sampling_phase & cluster vs. value
  contingency_table <- table(protein_data$sampling_phase, protein_data$cluster_maximum_6prot_omi, protein_data$value)
  
  # Convert the array to a tidy data frame
  df <- as.data.frame.table(contingency_table) |> 
    rename(sampling_phase = Var1, cluster = Var2, value = Var3, count = Freq) |> 
    pivot_wider(names_from = value, values_from = count, values_fill = list(count = 0)) |> 
    rename(`FALSE` = `FALSE`, `TRUE` = `TRUE`)
  
  return(df)
})


names(seropos_cluster_comp_perphase) <- unique(covid_proteins)
```

### Agreement across RBD variants (Supplementary Figure 3):

Let the RBD WT variant be 100%, and then the percentage of positive for the other variants, sort in decreasing order.

```{r}
rbd_variants <- colnames(cls)[grep("rbd", colnames(cls))]
rbd_variants <- rbd_variants[-grep("^rbd$|0.4", rbd_variants)]

reference_col <- "rbd.wt.sars.2"  # Define reference variant

rbd_agreement_df <- cls |>
  select( sample_name, all_of(rbd_variants)) |>
  left_join(
    serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo |>
      select(sample_name, sampling_phase, idnr),
    by = "sample_name"
  ) 

# Count number of samples positive for reference
total_reference_positive <- sum(rbd_agreement_df[[reference_col]] == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE)

# Compute agreement percentage for each variant
agreement_results <- lapply(rbd_variants, function(variant) {
  # Count samples where reference is TRUE and variant is also TRUE
  agreement_count <- sum(rbd_agreement_df[[variant]] == "TRUE" & rbd_agreement_df[[reference_col]] == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Compute percentage agreement
  percentage_agreement <- (agreement_count / total_reference_positive) * 100
  
  return(data.frame(variant = variant, percentage = percentage_agreement))
}) |> 
  bind_rows()


# Step 3: Sort variants by agreement percentage (highest to lowest)
agreement_results <- agreement_results |> arrange(desc(percentage))

# Step 4: Visualize as a bar plot
agreement_results |> filter(! variant == "rbd.nearly.omicron") |>
  ggplot( aes(x = reorder(variant, -percentage), y = percentage)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, show.legend = FALSE, alpha = 0.6, col = "white", fill = "grey", size=2) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  labs(title = "Agreement of RBD Variants with rbd.wt",
       x = "RBD Variant",
       y = "Agreement Percentage (%)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  geom_hline( yintercept = 75, linetype = "dashed")

```

```{r}
### Antibody levels against time since vaccination
vaccinated_subjects <- serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo |> filter(vaccdose1 == "Yes") |> pull(idnr) |> unique()
nucleocapsid_positive_samples <- long_cls |> filter(protein == "nucleocapsid.full" & value == "TRUE") |> pull(sample_name) ## samples taken after infection

serology_vaccination_data <- serology_norm_rm_empty_sinfo |>
  #filter(vaccdose1 == "Yes" & is.na(sminet_case)) |>
  filter( idnr %in% vaccinated_subjects) |> 
  filter(!sample_name %in% nucleocapsid_positive_samples) |>
  mutate(
    sampling_time = as.Date(sampling_time),
    dose1_date = as.Date(date1),
    dose2_date = as.Date(date2),
    dose3_date = as.Date(date3)
  ) |>
  rowwise() |>  # Process each row individually
  mutate(
    # Combine dose dates into a list and filter those before sampling_time
    dose_dates = list(na.omit(c(dose1_date, dose2_date, dose3_date))),
    dose_dates_before_sampling = list(dose_dates[dose_dates < sampling_time]),
    
    # Identify the closest dose date before the sampling time
    closest_dose_date = max(dose_dates_before_sampling, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Calculate time since the closest dose in months
    time_since_any_dose = time_length(interval(closest_dose_date, sampling_time), "days"),
    
    # Add the time to vaccine dose 1 to the samples that were taken before vaccination:
    time_since_any_dose = case_when( time_since_any_dose == "Inf" ~ time_length(interval(dose1_date, sampling_time), "days"),
                                     T ~ time_since_any_dose),
    
    
    # Determine which dose was closest
    closest_dose = case_when(
      closest_dose_date == dose1_date ~ "dose1",
      closest_dose_date == dose2_date ~ "dose2",
      closest_dose_date == dose3_date ~ "dose3",
      TRUE ~ "No dose"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

  mutate( time_since_vaccination_group = case_when(
    time_since_any_dose < 0 ~ "pre",

    values = protein_colors  # Define colors for points (analyte)
  ) +
  new_scale_colour() +
  # SMOOTH LINES - Use family colors
  geom_smooth(method = 'loess', aes(color = family, fill = family), formula = y ~ x) +  
  theme_classic(12) +
  # TWO DIFFERENT COLOR MAPPINGS
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Family", 
    values = family_colors  # Define colors for points (analyte)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Family", 
    values = family_colors   # Define colors for smooth lines (family)
  ) +
  # HORIZONTAL LINES - Use viral protein family colors
  geom_hline(
    data = cutoff_values, 
    aes(yintercept = cutoff, linetype = analyte, color = family)  
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Anti-N and S signal after infection",
    subtitle = "Exclude vaccinated subjects",
    y = "Normalized log2 MFI",
    x = "Months since confirmed infection"
  )
```

# Proteomics analysis code:

### Linear models protein \~ traits (BMI, sex, age, smoking):

```{r}

library(lmerTest)

model_vars <- c("chc19aldy", "male", "smoke_c19_3", "BMI_c19" )

olink_proteins_oi <- colnames(olink_bamse_protpqn_blank_rm_intnorm)[c(2:(ncol(olink_bamse_protpqn_blank_rm_intnorm))-1)]

# Initialize a data frame to store the results
results_lm_p2 <- data.frame(protein = character(), var = character(), adj_R2 = numeric(), intercept = numeric(), slope = numeric(),  p_value_intercept = numeric(),  p_value_slope = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Loop over each protein and each model variable
for (protein in olink_proteins_oi) {
  for (var in model_vars) {
    
    formula <- as.formula(paste(protein, "~", var))
    
    phase2_data <- olink_bamse_protpqn_blank_rm_intnorm_si_ex |> filter(sampling_phase == "Phase 2")
    
    # Fit the linear mixed model
    model <- tryCatch(
      lm(formula, data = phase2_data),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    
    adjr2 <- summary(lm(formula, data = phase2_data))$adj.r.squared
    
    estimates <- if (!is.null(model)) {
      summary(model)$coefficients[, "Estimate"]
    } else {
      NA
    }
    
    p_values <- if (!is.null(model)) {
      summary(model)$coefficients[, "Pr(>|t|)"]
    } else {
      NA
    }
    
    
    results_lm_p2 <- rbind(results_lm_p2, data.frame(protein = protein, var = var,  adj_R2 = adjr2, intercept = estimates[1], slope = estimates[2] ,  p_value_intercept = p_values[1], p_value_slope =  p_values[2] ))
    
    
  }
  
}

# FDR adjust data:
results_lm_p2 <- results_lm_p2 |> 
  group_by(var) |> 
  mutate(fdr_slope = p.adjust(p_value_slope, method = "fdr")) |> 
  ungroup()

write.csv(results_lm_p2, "lm phase 2 against information_protpqn intesnity data_fdr across variable_250928.csv")


## Plot fdr vs slope:
plot_list <- lapply(model_vars, function(variable) {
  dat <- results_lm_p2_in |>
    filter(var == variable) |>
    mutate(
      rank_sig = min_rank(fdr_slope),
      label = case_when(
        rank_sig <= 10 ~ protein,
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      significant_color = case_when(fdr_slope < 0.05 ~ "sig",
                                    TRUE ~ "not sig"),
      max_abs_slope = max(abs(slope), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = slope, y = -log10(fdr_slope), col = significant_color)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_blank(aes(x = max_abs_slope)) +
    geom_blank(aes(x = -max_abs_slope)) +
    theme_classic(10) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("not sig" = "grey79", "sig" = "black")) +
    ylim(0, 40) +
    labs( title = paste0(variable)) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  
  # Only add geom_text if there is at least one "sig"
  if (any(dat$significant_color == "sig")) {
    p <- p + geom_text(
      data = dat,
      aes(label = label),
      size = 3,
      color = "black",
      nudge_y = 0.15,
      check_overlap = TRUE
    )
  }
  
  return(p)
})

plot_list[[4]] + plot_list[[1]] + plot_list[[2]] + plot_list[[3]] + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```

```{r}
## LMM against storage time, adjust for sex and do this only for the serocluster 1 samples

## Take out the serocluster 1 samples that remain in serocluster 1 all phases:

#library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
# Initialize an empty data frame to store the results
lm_results_storagetime <- data.frame(protein = character(),
                                     slope = numeric(),
                                     p_value = numeric(),
                                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

olink_proteins <- olink_proteins_oi


plot_list <- list()
# Loop over each protein
for (protein in olink_proteins) {
  
  # Perform the data selection and linear modeling
  data <- olink_bamse_protpqn_blank_rm_intnorm |>
    dplyr::rename(sampleid = sample_id) |> 
    # select(!sample_id) |>
    left_join(samp_info_key, by = "sampleid") |>
    left_join(sample_info, by = c("samplename" = "sample_name")) |>
    mutate(elution_date = as.Date("2022-09-30"),
           sampling_time = as.Date(sampling_time),
           storage_time = time_length(interval(sampling_time, elution_date), "months"),
           sampling_phase = plot_variable) |>
    left_join( sample_info_wide |> dplyr::select(idnr, male), by = "idnr") |>
    mutate(sex = case_when( male == 0 ~ "female",
                            male == 1 ~ "male")) |>
    filter( samplename %in% serocluster1_3p)
  #filter(!is.na(idnr))
  
  
  # Fit a linear mixed model
  lmer_fit <- lmerTest::lmer(data[[protein]] ~ storage_time + (1 | idnr) + sex, data = data)
  
  # Extract fixed effects
  lmer_summary <- summary(lmer_fit)$coefficients
  
  # Extract slope and p-value for storage_timeserocluster
  slope <- lmer_summary["storage_time", "Estimate"]
  p_value <- lmer_summary["storage_time", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  
  # Store the results
  lm_results_storagetime <- rbind(lm_results_storagetime, data.frame(protein = protein,
                                                                     slope = slope,
                                                                     p_value = p_value,
                                                                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE))

  
}
```

### **Spearman and intraclass correlation across repeated samplings** (Fig. S17):

**Calculate Inter-class correlations. ICC \> 0.8 are considered as stable:**

The Intraclass correlation is used as a measure of association when studying the reliability of raters.

ICC (close to 1) indicates high similarity between rater's scores.

ICC (close to 0) indicates rater's scores are not similar.

Usage:

```         
ICC(x,missing=TRUE,alpha=.05,lmer=TRUE,check.keys=FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(psych)

#------------------------------ Correlation and ICC per protein:
#Spearman correlation:
corr_matrix_list <- lapply(olink_proteins_oi, function(protein) {
  
  
  # Extract data for the given protein
  protein_data <-  olink_bamse_protpqn_blank_rm_intnorm_si |>
    #select(samplename, idnr, sampling_phase, cluster_maximum_6prot_omi, !!sym(protein))
  select(samplename, idnr, sampling_phase, !!sym(protein))
  
  # Split data by phase
  phase1 <- protein_data %>% filter(sampling_phase == "Phase 1")
  phase2 <- protein_data %>% filter(sampling_phase == "Phase 2")
  phase3 <- protein_data %>% filter(sampling_phase == "Phase 3")
  
  # Merge phase data on sample names
  phase1_vs_phase2 <- merge(phase1, phase2, by = "idnr", suffixes = c("_P1", "_P2"))
  phase2_vs_phase3 <- merge(phase2, phase3, by = "idnr", suffixes = c("_P2", "_P3"))
  phase1_vs_phase3 <- merge(phase1, phase3, by = "idnr", suffixes = c("_P1", "_P3")) 
  
  # Calculate Spearman's rho for Phase 1 vs Phase 2
  rho_phase1_vs_phase2 <- cor(phase1_vs_phase2[[paste0(protein, "_P1")]], 
                              phase1_vs_phase2[[paste0(protein, "_P2")]], 
                              method = "spearman", 
                              use = "complete.obs")
  
  
  # Calculate Spearman's rho for Phase 2 vs Phase 3
  rho_phase2_vs_phase3 <- cor(phase2_vs_phase3[[paste0(protein, "_P2")]], 
                              phase2_vs_phase3[[paste0(protein, "_P3")]], 
                              method = "spearman", 
                              use = "complete.obs")
  
  rho_phase1_vs_phase3 <- cor(phase1_vs_phase3[[paste0(protein, "_P1")]], 
                              phase1_vs_phase3[[paste0(protein, "_P3")]], 
                              method = "spearman", 
                              use = "complete.obs")
  
  
  # Return the correlation values
  return(c(IDnr = protein, corr_v1v2 = rho_phase1_vs_phase2, corr_v2v3 = rho_phase2_vs_phase3, corr_v1v3 = rho_phase1_vs_phase3))
  
})


# Convert list to data frame
corr_matrix_list_df <- do.call(rbind, corr_matrix_list)

colnames(corr_matrix_list_df) <- c("protein", "phase1_vs_phase2", "phase2_vs_phase3", "phase1_vs_phase3" )

corr_matrix_list_df <- as.data.frame(corr_matrix_list_df)
corr_matrix_list_df[,2:4] <- apply(corr_matrix_list_df[,2:4], 2, as.numeric)

corr_plot_protein_intnorm <- corr_matrix_list_df |>
  pivot_longer( cols = contains("phase" ), names_to = "Comparison", values_to = "spearman" ) |>
  ggplot( aes( x = spearman, col = Comparison, fill = Comparison)) +
  geom_density( alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_classic(11) +
  scale_fill_brewer( palette = "Pastel2") +
  scale_color_brewer( palette = "Pastel2") +
  labs(title = "Protein correlation", x = "Spearman's Rho") +
  theme( # remove the vertical grid lines
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank() ,
    # explicitly set the horizontal lines (or they will disappear too)
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line( size=.1, color="black", linetype = "dotted" ) 
  ) +
  xlim(-1, 1)

##                      ICC (Supp Fig S17b)
icc_matrix_list <- lapply(olink_proteins_oi, function(protein) {
  
  
  # Extract data for the given protein
  protein_data <- olink_bamse_protpqn_blank_rm_intnorm_si |>
    dplyr::select(samplename, idnr, sampling_phase, !!sym(protein))
  
  # Split data by phase
  phase1 <- protein_data %>% filter(sampling_phase == "Phase 1")
  phase2 <- protein_data %>% filter(sampling_phase == "Phase 2")
  phase3 <- protein_data %>% filter(sampling_phase == "Phase 3")
  
  # Merge phase data on sample names
  phase1_vs_phase2 <- merge(phase1, phase2, by = "idnr", suffixes = c("_P1", "_P2"))
  
  phase2_vs_phase3 <- merge(phase2, phase3, by = "idnr", suffixes = c("_P2", "_P3"))
  
  phase1_vs_phase3 <- merge(phase1, phase3, by = "idnr", suffixes = c("_P1", "_P3"))
  
  # Calculate ICC for Phase 1 vs Phase 2
  icc_model <-  psych::ICC(cbind(phase1_vs_phase2[[paste0(protein, "_P1")]],
                                 phase1_vs_phase2[[paste0(protein, "_P2")]]), alpha = 0.05, lmer = TRUE, check.keys = TRUE)
  
  icc3_v12 <- icc_model$results$ICC[3]
  
  # Calculate ICC for Phase 2 vs Phase 3
  icc_model <-  psych::ICC(cbind(phase2_vs_phase3[[paste0(protein, "_P2")]],
                                 phase2_vs_phase3[[paste0(protein, "_P3")]]), alpha = 0.05, lmer = TRUE, check.keys = TRUE)
  
  icc3_v23 <- icc_model$results$ICC[3]
  
  # Calculate ICC for Phase 1 vs Phase 3
  icc_model <-  psych::ICC(cbind(phase1_vs_phase3[[paste0(protein, "_P1")]],
                                 phase1_vs_phase3[[paste0(protein, "_P3")]]), alpha = 0.05, lmer = TRUE, check.keys = TRUE)
  
  icc3_v13 <- icc_model$results$ICC[3]
  
  
  # Return the correlation values
  return(c(protname = protein, corr_v1v2 = icc3_v12, corr_v2v3 = icc3_v23, corr_v1v3 =  icc3_v13 ))
  # wrap_plots(plot1 + plot2 + plot_layout(guides = "collect"))
  
})
```

Function for lm analysis comparing the change in protein levels between different groups:

```{r}
#### Function for performing the lm analysis:
library(ggh4x)
library(ggrepel)

# linear analysis with possibility to do delta delta
lm_analysis <- function(data_in, sample_id = "sampleid", predictor, covar = NULL, stratify_by = NULL,
                        difference_col = NULL, individual_id = NULL, differences_between = NULL) {
  # data_in, list containing data frames with the protein measurements in wide format (named `values`) and sample information in wide format (named `sinfo`). A common sample identifier should exist in both
  # predictor, name of column that should be the main predictor. Must exist in `sinfo` in `data_in` and be numeric.
  # sample_id, name of column in both `values` and `sinfo` that matches the rows of the two data frames
  # covar, vector of column names in `sinfo` that should be included as covariates.
  # stratify_by, name of column to stratify the analysis by (default is NULL, no stratification)
  # difference_col, if differences should be used as the outcome, the name of the column containing the values to calculate difference between. E.g. if two samples come from the same individual at two time points, `difference_col` may be a time point column. Default is NULL (no difference calculation)
  # individual_id, name of column containing individual identifiers. The differences in `difference_col` will be calculated per `individual_id`. Default is NULL (no difference calculation)
  # differences_between, vector of two values existing in `difference_col` to calculate the difference in protein levels between. Default is NULL (no difference calculation)
  
  diff_null <- c(is.null(difference_col), is.null(individual_id), is.null(differences_between))
  if (!sum(diff_null) %in% c(0, 3)) {
    stop("'difference_col', 'individual_id', and 'differences_between' all need to be specified or all NULL.")
  }
  
  # Make formula for linear model
  lm_formula <- paste0("value ~ ", predictor,
                       # Add covariates
                       ifelse(!is.null(covar), " + ", ""),
                       paste0(covar, collapse = " + "))
  
  lm_analysis <- data_in$values %>%
    # Add sample info (columns with covariates, stratification variable, difference variable, IDs)
    left_join(data_in$sinfo %>%
                dplyr::select(all_of(c(sample_id, predictor, covar, difference_col, stratify_by, individual_id))),
              by = sample_id) %>%
    (\(x) {
      if (!is.null(individual_id)) {filter(x, !is.na(get(individual_id)))} else {x}
    })() %>%
    # Convert for long format for analysis
    pivot_longer(cols = -all_of(c(sample_id, predictor, covar, difference_col, stratify_by, individual_id)),
                 names_to = "assay", values_to = "value") %>%
    # Calculate difference in values if columns are provided
    (\(x) {
      if (!is.null(difference_col)) {
        # Perform calculation per individual (individual_id) and protein (assay)
        x %>% group_by(across(all_of(individual_id)), assay) %>%
          # Calculate difference between second and first value of differences_between
          mutate(value = value[get(difference_col) == differences_between[2]] -
                   value[get(difference_col) == differences_between[1]]) %>%
          ungroup() %>%
          # Keep only unique differences for each individual (previous step keeps all rows, leaving repeat values)
          distinct(across(all_of(c(individual_id, "assay"))), .keep_all = T)
      }
      else {x}
    }) %>%
    # Perform analysis per protein and stratification group
    group_by(across(all_of(c("assay", stratify_by)))) %>% nest() %>%
    mutate(median_diff = map(data, \(x) median(x$value[x[[predictor]] == sort(unique(x[[predictor]]))[[2]]]) -
                               median(x$value[x[[predictor]] == sort(unique(x[[predictor]]))[[1]]])),
           median_grp1 = map(data, \(x) median(x$value[x[[predictor]] == sort(unique(x[[predictor]]))[[1]]])),
           median_grp2 = map(data, \(x) median(x$value[x[[predictor]] == sort(unique(x[[predictor]]))[[2]]])),
           lm_res = map(data, \(x) lm(formula = lm_formula, data = x) %>% summary())) %>%
    mutate(# Pick out beta and p-value
      estimate = map(lm_res, \(x) x$coefficients %>% as.data.frame() %>%
                       rownames_to_column("rn") %>% filter(str_detect(rn, predictor)) %>%
                       pull(Estimate)),
      p_value = map(lm_res, \(x) x$coefficients%>% as.data.frame() %>%
                      rownames_to_column("rn") %>% filter(str_detect(rn, predictor)) %>%
                      pull(`Pr(>|t|)`))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(assay, !!stratify_by, median_diff, median_grp1, median_grp2, estimate, p_value) %>%
    unnest(c(median_diff, median_grp1, median_grp2, estimate, p_value)) %>%
    # Calculate FDR
    mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr"), .by = !!stratify_by)
  
  grp1 <- sort(unique(data_in$sinfo[[predictor]]))[[1]]
  grp2 <- sort(unique(data_in$sinfo[[predictor]]))[[2]]
  
  return(list(results = lm_analysis, formula = lm_formula, predictor = predictor,
              covariates = covar, computed_differences = ifelse(is.null(difference_col), F, T),
              difference_params = list(difference_column = difference_col,
                                       differences_between = differences_between,
                                       individual_id = individual_id),
              stratify_by = stratify_by,
              groups = c(grp1, grp2)))
}

# plotting in volcano and mirrored manhattan plot
plot_lm_results <- function(results, colr_by = NA, colr_scale = NULL, sep_by_colr = T,
                            ns_grey = T, signif_threshold = 0.05) {
  
  # Stratified analysis
  strat_log <- !is.null(results$stratify_by)
  strat_name <- results$stratify_by
  
  # Make custom colour scale if non-significant values should be coloured differently
  if (is.null(colr_scale)) {
    if (!all(is.na(colr_by))) {
      # Values to colour by are provided
      
      if (ns_grey) {
        # Introduce a grey "not significant" category
        colr_scale <- scale_colour_manual(
          values = c(brewer.pal(length(unique(colr_by)), "Pastel1"), "grey90") %>%
            setNames(c(as.character(sort(unique(colr_by))), "ns"))
        )
      } else {
        colr_scale <- scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Pastel1")
      }
    } else {
      # No values to colour by are provided
      
      if (ns_grey) {
        # Significant points black, non-significant points grey
        colr_scale <- scale_colour_manual(values = c("Significant" = "black", "ns" = "grey90"))
      }
    }
  }
  
  plt_dat <- results$results %>%
    # Add colouring categories
    (\(x) {
      if (!all(is.na(colr_by))) mutate(x, colr = colr_by)
      else mutate(x, colr = case_when(fdr < signif_threshold ~ "Significant", T ~ "ns"))
    }) %>%
    # Prepare for stratified data
    (\(x) {
      if (strat_log) mutate(x, assay = paste0(assay, "_", get(strat_name)))
      else x
    })()
  
  if (!all(is.na(colr_by))) {
    # Order proteins by colour
    plt_dat <- arrange(plt_dat, colr, assay) %>% mutate(assay = as.integer(factor(assay, levels = assay)))
  }
  
  # Get values for vertical lines to separate colours
  vlines <- plt_dat %>% count(colr) %>% mutate(vline = cumsum(n) + 0.5) %>% dplyr::slice(-nrow(.))
  
  # Change colour name to 'ns' if not significant (if desired)
  if (ns_grey) {
    plt_dat <- mutate(plt_dat,
                      # Keep the original colour names if needed
                      colr_og = colr,
                      colr = case_when(fdr < signif_threshold ~ colr, T ~ "ns"),
                      colr = factor(colr, levels = c(setdiff(as.character(sort(unique(colr))), "ns"), "ns"))) %>%
      # Change order of rows to ensure that ns points are underneath other points
      arrange(desc(colr))
  }
  
  # Mirrored Manhattan plot of results
  mmplt <- plt_dat %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = assay, y = median_diff, size = -log10(fdr),
               colour = if (!all(is.na(colr_by)) | ns_grey) colr else NULL))
  if (sep_by_colr) {mmplt <- mmplt +
    geom_vline(xintercept = vlines$vline, colour = "grey", linetype = "dashed")}
  mmplt <- mmplt +
    geom_point() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
    colr_scale +
    # Make y-axis limits symmetric around 0
    scale_y_continuous(limits = center_limits()) +
    labs(y = "∆Change", x = NULL, colour = "Panel", size = "-log10(FDR)") +
    theme_classic(14) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.line.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)))
  if (strat_log) {
    mmplt <- mmplt + facet_wrap(as.formula(paste0("~ ", strat_name)), ncol = 1)
  }
  
  # Volcano plot
  vplt <- plt_dat %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = median_diff, y = -log10(fdr), colour = colr)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, show.legend = F) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(signif_threshold), linetype = "dashed") +
    colr_scale +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = center_limits()) +
    theme_classic() +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(plt_dat, fdr < 0.05),
      aes(label = str_remove(assay, "_Phase \\d")),  # Use the `protein` column as the label
      color = "black",
      box.padding = 0.2,
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
    geom_vline( xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", col = "grey") #+
  #labs( title = paste("Comparing ", comparison))
  # Faceting based on panels and stratification (Volcano on top of each ohter)
  # if (strat_log | !all(is.na(colr_by))) {
  #   vplt <- vplt + facet_grid(if (strat_log) {rows = vars(get(strat_name))} else {rows = NULL},
  #                             if (sep_by_colr) {cols = case_when(ns_grey ~ vars(colr_og), T ~ vars(colr))}
  #                             else {cols = NULL},
  #                             axes = "all_x")
  # }
  # Faceting based on panels and stratification (Volcano next to each other)
  if (strat_log || !all(is.na(colr_by))) {
    vplt <- vplt + facet_grid(cols = if (strat_log) {vars(get(strat_name))} else {NULL},
                              rows = if (sep_by_colr) {case_when(ns_grey ~ vars(colr_og), T ~ vars(colr))}
                              else {NULL}, axes = "all_y")
  }
  
  rm(list = setdiff(ls(), c("mmplt", "vplt", "colr_by", "ns_grey", "strat_log", "strat_name")))
  
  return(list(mm = mmplt, volcano = vplt))
}
```

### Comparing protein levels in seronegative versus infected subjects (Fig. S18):

```{r}

### Comparing change in protein levels in phase 1 and phase 2 between seronegative and infected:
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(progress)

# PARAMETERS
n_runs <- 100
#min_percentage <- 0.70   # final required frequency
fdr_cutoff <- 0.05
seed_base <- 123

# Precompute group sizes
n12 <- time_adjusted_data_for_lm %>%
  filter(sampling_phase != "Phase 3", clust_traj12 == "12") %>%
  distinct(idnr) %>% nrow()

# Get random IDs in group 11
group11_ids <- time_adjusted_data_for_lm %>%
  filter(sampling_phase != "Phase 3", clust_traj12 == "11") %>%
  distinct(idnr) %>% pull(idnr)

# Function for subsampling iteration
run_one_subsample <- function(i) {
  set.seed(seed_base + i)
  
  # randomly sample n12 subjects from group11 (with replacement)
  sampled_11 <- sample(group11_ids, size = n12, replace = TRUE)
  
  # build data_list for analysis: keep group12 and the sampled group11 subjects
  data_subset <- time_adjusted_data_for_lm %>%
    filter(sampling_phase != "Phase 3") %>%
    filter(clust_traj12 == "12" | idnr %in% sampled_11)
  
  data_list <- list(
    values = data_subset %>%
      dplyr::select(sample_id, all_of(olink_proteins_ta)),
    sinfo = data_subset %>%
      dplyr::select(idnr, sample_id, sampling_phase, clust_traj12, male)
  )
  
  # Run within-phase comparison:
  # lm_11_12 <- lm_analysis(data_list, "sample_id", predictor = "clust_traj12", covar = "male", stratify_by = "sampling_phase")
  
  # Run the delta-delta analysis (difference between in change between Phase1 and Phase2 for each group)
  lm_dd <- lm_analysis(
    data_list,
    "sample_id",
    predictor = "clust_traj12",
    covar = "male",
    difference_col = "sampling_phase",
    individual_id = "idnr",
    differences_between = c("Phase 1", "Phase 2")
  )
  
  # lm_dd$results expected to be a data.frame with columns: assay, estimate, pvalue, fdr
  res <- lm_dd$results %>%
    mutate(iter = i) %>%
    dplyr::select(assay, median_diff, estimate, p_value, fdr, iter)
  
  # Return list of significant assays this run
  sig_assays <- res %>% filter(fdr < fdr_cutoff) %>% pull(assay)
  
  list(results = res, significant = sig_assays)
}



# Run many iterations (serial)
pb <- progress_bar$new(total = n_runs)
all_iter_results <- vector("list", n_runs)
for (i in seq_len(n_runs)) {
  iter_out <- tryCatch({
    out <- run_one_subsample(i)
    pb$tick()
    out
  }, error = function(e) {
    pb$tick()
    message("Error in iteration ", i, ": ", e$message)
    list(results = tibble(assay = character(), median_diff = numeric(), estimate = numeric(), pvalue = numeric(), fdr = numeric(), iter = integer()),
         significant = character(0))
  })
  all_iter_results[[i]] <- iter_out
}

# -----------------------
# Aggregate outputs
# -----------------------

# 1) Frequency table: how many times each assay was significant
all_sig_lists <- map(all_iter_results, "significant")
all_sig_flat <- unlist(all_sig_lists)
protein_counts <- sort(table(all_sig_flat), decreasing = TRUE)
protein_counts_df <- tibble(
  assay = names(protein_counts),
  count = as.integer(protein_counts),
  freq = count / n_runs
)

# 2) Collect all per-iteration results (estimates, p-values)
all_results_df <-all_iter_results %>%
  map("results") %>%
  list_rbind()

# compute median estimate, proportion of runs with significant p (or fdr), direction consistency
summary_df <- all_results_df %>%
  group_by(assay) %>%
  summarise(
    median_median_diff = median( median_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_estimate = median(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_estimate = mean(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_pos = mean(estimate > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_neg = mean(estimate < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_sig = mean(fdr < fdr_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_non_na = sum(!is.na(estimate)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(prop_sig), desc(prop_pos))

# Function for bootstrap iteration
run_one_bootstrap_within_phase <- function(i) {
  set.seed(seed_base + i)
  
  # randomly sample n12 subjects from group11 (WITH replacement for bootstrap)
  sampled_11 <- sample(group11_ids, size = n12, replace = TRUE)
  
  # build data_list for analysis: keep group12 and the sampled group11 subjects
  data_subset <- time_adjusted_data_for_lm %>%
    filter(sampling_phase != "Phase 3") %>%
    filter(clust_traj12 == "12" | idnr %in% sampled_11)
  
  data_list <- list(
    values = data_subset %>%
      dplyr::select(sample_id, all_of(olink_proteins_ta)),     # adjust variable name if needed
    sinfo = data_subset %>%
      dplyr::select(idnr, sample_id, sampling_phase, clust_traj12, male)
  )
  
  # Run the delta-delta analysis (difference in change between Phase1 and Phase2 for each group)
  lm_dd <- lm_analysis(
    data_list,
    "sample_id",
    predictor = "clust_traj12",
    covar = "male",
    stratify_by = "sampling_phase"
    # difference_col = "sampling_phase",
    #  individual_id = "idnr",
    # differences_between = c("Phase 1", "Phase 2")
  )
  
  # lm_dd$results expected to be a data.frame with columns: assay, estimate, p_value, fdr
  res <- lm_dd$results %>%
    mutate(iter = i) %>%
    dplyr::select(assay, sampling_phase, median_diff, estimate, p_value, fdr, iter)
  
  # Return list of significant assays this run
  sig_assays_p1 <- res %>%filter(sampling_phase == "Phase 1") %>% filter(fdr < fdr_cutoff) %>% pull(assay)
  
  sig_assays_p2 <- res %>%filter(sampling_phase == "Phase 2") %>% filter(fdr < fdr_cutoff) %>% pull(assay)
  
  list(results = res, significant_p1 = sig_assays_p1, significant_p2 = sig_assays_p2)
}

### Plot protein level and calculate significant using wilcox:
## Calculate statistical result function:

# Function to perform statistical tests for each protein
calculate_protein_stats <- # function(proteins_of_interest, data) {
  function(proteins_of_interest_tad, data) {
    
    results_list <- list()
    
    #for(protein in proteins_of_interest) {
    for(protein in proteins_of_interest_tad) {
      
      cat("Processing protein:", protein, "\n")
      
      # Prepare data for this protein
      protein_data <- data %>% 
        filter(idnr %in% sminet_infected_subjects) %>%
        mutate(
          time_since_sminet = as.Date(sampling_time) - as.Date(sminet_date),
          time_since_sminet_group = case_when(
            time_since_sminet < 0 ~ "pre",
            time_since_sminet >= 0 & time_since_sminet <= 30 ~ "0-30",
            time_since_sminet > 30 ~ "30+"
          ),
          time_since_sminet_group = factor(time_since_sminet_group, levels = c("pre", "0-30", "30+"))
        ) %>%
        filter(Time_Sample_Dose1 < 0) %>%
        filter( ! sampling_phase == "Phase 3") |> # this is only one sample. remove so we only have one pre and post sample per subject
        pivot_longer(cols = all_of(proteins_of_interest[-grep("PKLR|GLOD4|DNPH1", proteins_of_interest)]), names_to = "assay", values_to = "npx") %>%
        filter(assay == protein)
      
      # Initialize results for this protein
      protein_results <- data.frame(
        protein = protein,
        p_value_pre_vs_0_30 = NA,
        eff_size_pre_vs_0_30 = NA,     # <-- Added
        p_value_pre_vs_30plus = NA,
        eff_size_pre_vs_30plus = NA,   # <-- Added
        p_value_0_30_vs_30plus = NA,
        eff_size_0_30_vs_30plus = NA,  # <-- Added
        n_pre = 0,
        n_0_30 = 0,
        n_30plus = 0,
        n_paired_pre_0_30 = 0,
        n_paired_pre_30plus = 0,
        test_type_pre_0_30 = NA,
        test_type_pre_30plus = NA,
        test_type_0_30_30plus = NA
      )
      
      # Count samples in each group
      protein_results$n_pre <- sum(protein_data$time_since_sminet_group == "pre", na.rm = TRUE)
      protein_results$n_0_30 <- sum(protein_data$time_since_sminet_group == "0-30", na.rm = TRUE)
      protein_results$n_30plus <- sum(protein_data$time_since_sminet_group == "30+", na.rm = TRUE)
      
      # Test 1: pre vs 0-30 (paired if same subjects exist in both groups)
      pre_data <- protein_data %>% filter(time_since_sminet_group == "pre")
      group_0_30_data <- protein_data %>% filter(time_since_sminet_group == "0-30")
      
      # Find subjects present in both pre and 0-30 groups
      paired_subjects_pre_0_30 <- intersect(pre_data$idnr, group_0_30_data$idnr)
      protein_results$n_paired_pre_0_30 <- length(paired_subjects_pre_0_30)
      
      if(length(paired_subjects_pre_0_30) >= 5) {  # Minimum 5 pairs for meaningful paired test
        # Paired Wilcoxon
        pre_paired <- pre_data %>% filter(idnr %in% paired_subjects_pre_0_30) %>% arrange(idnr)
        group_0_30_paired <- group_0_30_data %>% filter(idnr %in% paired_subjects_pre_0_30) %>% arrange(idnr)
        
        if(nrow(pre_paired) == nrow(group_0_30_paired)) {
          test_result <- wilcox.test(x = pre_paired$npx, y = group_0_30_paired$npx, paired = TRUE, alternative = "two.sided")
          protein_results$p_value_pre_vs_0_30 <- test_result$p.value
          protein_results$eff_size_pre_vs_0_30 <- get_wilcox_effect_size(pre_paired$npx, group_0_30_paired$npx, paired = TRUE) #new
          protein_results$test_type_pre_0_30 = "paired_wilcoxon"
        }
      } else if(nrow(pre_data) >= 3 && nrow(group_0_30_data) >= 3) {
        # Unpaired t-test if not enough pairs
        # test_result <- t.test(pre_data$npx, group_0_30_data$npx, paired = FALSE)
        test_result <- wilcox.test(pre_data$npx, group_0_30_data$npx, paired = FALSE)
        protein_results$p_value_pre_vs_0_30 <- test_result$p.value
        protein_results$eff_size_pre_vs_0_30 <- get_wilcox_effect_size(pre_data$npx, group_0_30_data$npx, paired = FALSE) #new
        protein_results$test_type_pre_0_30 = "unpaired_wilcoxon"
      }
      
      # Test 2: pre vs 30+ (paired if same subjects exist in both groups)
      group_30plus_data <- protein_data %>% filter(time_since_sminet_group == "30+")
      
      # Find subjects present in both pre and 30+ groups
      paired_subjects_pre_30plus <- intersect(pre_data$idnr, group_30plus_data$idnr)
      protein_results$n_paired_pre_30plus <- length(paired_subjects_pre_30plus)
      
      if(length(paired_subjects_pre_30plus) >= 5) {  # Minimum 5 pairs for meaningful paired test
        # Paired Wilcoxon
        pre_paired <- pre_data %>% filter(idnr %in% paired_subjects_pre_30plus) %>% arrange(idnr)
        group_30plus_paired <- group_30plus_data %>% filter(idnr %in% paired_subjects_pre_30plus) %>% arrange(idnr)
        
        if(nrow(pre_paired) == nrow(group_30plus_paired)) {
          test_result <- wilcox.test(pre_paired$npx, group_30plus_paired$npx, paired = TRUE )
          protein_results$p_value_pre_vs_30plus <- test_result$p.value
          protein_results$eff_size_pre_vs_30plus <- get_wilcox_effect_size(pre_paired$npx, group_30plus_paired$npx, paired = TRUE) #new
          protein_results$test_type_pre_30plus = "paired_wilcoxon"
        }
      } else if(nrow(pre_data) >= 3 && nrow(group_30plus_data) >= 3) {
        test_result <- wilcox.test(pre_data$npx, group_30plus_data$npx, paired = FALSE)
        protein_results$p_value_pre_vs_30plus <- test_result$p.value
        protein_results$eff_size_pre_vs_30plus <- get_wilcox_effect_size(pre_data$npx, group_30plus_data$npx, paired = FALSE)
        protein_results$test_type_pre_30plus = "unpaired_wilcoxon"
      }
      
      # Test 3: 0-30 vs 30+ (unpaired - different subjects)
      if(nrow(group_0_30_data) >= 3 && nrow(group_30plus_data) >= 3) {
        test_result <- wilcox.test(group_0_30_data$npx, group_30plus_data$npx, paired = FALSE)
        protein_results$p_value_0_30_vs_30plus <- test_result$p.value
        protein_results$eff_size_0_30_vs_30plus <- get_wilcox_effect_size(group_0_30_data$npx, group_30plus_data$npx, paired = FALSE) #new
        protein_results$test_type_0_30_30plus = "unpaired_wilcoxon"
      }
      
      results_list[[protein]] <- protein_results
    }
    
    # Combine results
    all_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
    
    # Apply FDR correction to each p-value column
    all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_0_30 <- p.adjust(all_results$p_value_pre_vs_0_30, method = "fdr")
    all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_30plus <- p.adjust(all_results$p_value_pre_vs_30plus, method = "fdr")
    all_results$p_adj_0_30_vs_30plus <- p.adjust(all_results$p_value_0_30_vs_30plus, method = "fdr")
    
    # Add significance indicators
    all_results$sig_pre_vs_0_30 <- case_when(
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_0_30 < 0.001 ~ "***",
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_0_30 < 0.01 ~ "**",
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_0_30 < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
    
    all_results$sig_pre_vs_30plus <- case_when(
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_30plus < 0.001 ~ "***",
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_30plus < 0.01 ~ "**",
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_30plus < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
    
    all_results$sig_0_30_vs_30plus <- case_when(
      all_results$p_adj_0_30_vs_30plus < 0.001 ~ "***",
      all_results$p_adj_0_30_vs_30plus < 0.01 ~ "**",
      all_results$p_adj_0_30_vs_30plus < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
    
    return(all_results)
    
  } ## END function

##                             Plot function for pre and post infection exl vaccinated:
create_plots_with_ggsignif <- function(proteins_of_interest, data, statistical_results) {
  
  # You'll need: install.packages("ggsignif")
  library(ggsignif)
  
  plot_list <- lapply(proteins_of_interest, function(protein) {
    
    # Get statistical results for this protein
    protein_stats <- statistical_results %>% 
      filter(protein == !!protein)
    
    # Prepare plot data
    plot_data <- data %>% 
      filter(idnr %in% sminet_infected_subjects) %>%
      mutate(
        time_since_sminet = as.Date(sampling_time) - as.Date(sminet_date),
        time_since_sminet_group = case_when(
          time_since_sminet < 0 ~ "pre",
          time_since_sminet >= 0 & time_since_sminet <= 30 ~ "0-30",
          time_since_sminet > 30 ~ "30+"
        ),
        time_since_sminet_group = factor(time_since_sminet_group, levels = c("pre", "0-30",  "30+"))
      ) %>%
      filter(Time_Sample_Dose1 < 0) %>%
      filter( ! sampling_phase == "Phase 3") |>
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(proteins_of_interest), names_to = "assay", values_to = "npx") %>%
      #pivot_longer(cols = proteins_of_interest, names_to = "assay", values_to = "npx") %>%
      filter(assay == protein)
    
    # Prepare significance annotations with test info
    comparisons <- list()
    annotations <- c()
    
    if(!is.na(protein_stats$p_adj_pre_vs_0_30)) {
      comparisons <- append(comparisons, list(c("pre", "0-30")))
      annotations <- c(annotations, paste0(
        protein_stats$sig_pre_vs_0_30, "\n(", protein_stats$test_type_pre_0_30, ")"
      ))
    }
    
    if(!is.na(protein_stats$p_adj_pre_vs_30plus)) {
      comparisons <- append(comparisons, list(c("pre", "30+")))
      annotations <- c(annotations, paste0(
        protein_stats$sig_pre_vs_30plus, "\n(", protein_stats$test_type_pre_30plus, ")"
      ))
    }
    
    if(!is.na(protein_stats$p_adj_0_30_vs_30plus)) {
      comparisons <- append(comparisons, list(c("0-30", "30+")))
      annotations <- c(annotations, paste0(
        protein_stats$sig_0_30_vs_30plus, "\n(", protein_stats$test_type_0_30_30plus, ")"
      ))
    }
  
    p1 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = time_since_sminet_group, y = npx, group = idnr)) +
      geom_beeswarm(aes( my_col = time_since_sminet_group, my_x = time_since_sminet_group))
    pb <- ggplot_build(p1)
    
    p <- ggplot(pb$data[[1]], aes(x = x, y = y, group = group)) +
      geom_line(aes(group = group), col = "grey80", alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_point( aes( color = my_col), size = 3, alpha = 0.6) +
      theme_classic() +
      scale_x_discrete() +
      labs(title = protein, y = "ProtPQN NPX [AU]", x = "Days since PCR+", subtitle = "Subjects with PCR+ confirmed infection, no vaccination") +
      geom_boxplot(aes(x = my_x, y = y, group = my_x), outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA) +
      scale_color_manual( values = c("grey", "red", "orange")) +
      guides(color="none")
    
    
    # Add significance brackets if we have comparisons
    if(length(comparisons) > 0) {
      p <- p + geom_signif(
        comparisons = comparisons,
        annotations = annotations,
        step_increase = 0.1,
        textsize = 2.5
      )
    }
    
    return(p)
  })
  
  names(plot_list) <- proteins_of_interest
  return(plot_list)
}

# Function to perform statistical tests for each protein
calculate_protein_stats_vi <- # function(proteins_of_interest, data) {
  function(proteins_of_interest_tad, data) {
    
    results_list <- list()
    
    #for(protein in proteins_of_interest) {
    for(protein in proteins_of_interest_tad) {
      
      cat("Processing protein:", protein, "\n")
      
      # Prepare data for this protein
      protein_data <- data %>% 
        filter(idnr %in% sminet_infected_subjects) %>%
        mutate(
          time_since_sminet = as.Date(sampling_time) - as.Date(sminet_date),
          time_since_sminet_group = case_when(
            time_since_sminet < 0 ~ "pre",
            time_since_sminet >= 0 & time_since_sminet <= 30 ~ "0-30",
            time_since_sminet > 30 ~ "30+"
          ),
          time_since_sminet_group = factor(time_since_sminet_group, levels = c("pre", "0-30", "30+"))
        ) %>%
        pivot_longer(cols = all_of(proteins_of_interest), names_to = "assay", values_to = "npx") %>%
        filter(assay == protein)
      
      # Initialize results for this protein
      protein_results <- data.frame(
        protein = protein,
        p_value_pre_vs_0_30 = NA,
        eff_size_pre_vs_0_30 = NA,     # <-- Added
        p_value_pre_vs_30plus = NA,
        eff_size_pre_vs_30plus = NA,   # <-- Added
        p_value_0_30_vs_30plus = NA,
        eff_size_0_30_vs_30plus = NA,  # <-- Added
        n_pre = 0,
        n_0_30 = 0,
        n_30plus = 0,
        n_paired_pre_0_30 = 0,
        n_paired_pre_30plus = 0,
        test_type_pre_0_30 = NA,
        test_type_pre_30plus = NA,
        test_type_0_30_30plus = NA
      )
      
      # Count samples in each group
      protein_results$n_pre <- sum(protein_data$time_since_sminet_group == "pre", na.rm = TRUE)
      protein_results$n_0_30 <- sum(protein_data$time_since_sminet_group == "0-30", na.rm = TRUE)
      protein_results$n_30plus <- sum(protein_data$time_since_sminet_group == "30+", na.rm = TRUE)
      
      # Test 1: pre vs 0-30 (paired if same subjects exist in both groups)
      pre_data <- protein_data %>% filter(time_since_sminet_group == "pre")
      group_0_30_data <- protein_data %>% filter(time_since_sminet_group == "0-30")
      
      # Find subjects present in both pre and 0-30 groups
      paired_subjects_pre_0_30 <- intersect(pre_data$idnr, group_0_30_data$idnr)
      protein_results$n_paired_pre_0_30 <- length(paired_subjects_pre_0_30)
      test_result <- wilcox.test(pre_data$npx, group_0_30_data$npx, paired = FALSE)
      protein_results$p_value_pre_vs_0_30 <- test_result$p.value
      protein_results$eff_size_pre_vs_0_30 <- get_wilcox_effect_size(pre_data$npx, group_0_30_data$npx, paired = FALSE) #new
      protein_results$test_type_pre_0_30 = "unpaired_wilcoxon"
      
      # }
      
      # Test 2: pre vs 30+ (paired if same subjects exist in both groups)
      group_30plus_data <- protein_data %>% filter(time_since_sminet_group == "30+")
      
      # Find subjects present in both pre and 30+ groups
      paired_subjects_pre_30plus <- intersect(pre_data$idnr, group_30plus_data$idnr)
      protein_results$n_paired_pre_30plus <- length(paired_subjects_pre_30plus)
      
      #if(length(paired_subjects_pre_30plus) >= 5) {  # Minimum 5 pairs for meaningful paired test
      # Paired t-test
      pre_paired <- pre_data %>% filter(idnr %in% paired_subjects_pre_30plus) %>% arrange(idnr)
      group_30plus_paired <- group_30plus_data %>% filter(idnr %in% paired_subjects_pre_30plus) %>% arrange(idnr)
      
      test_result <- wilcox.test(pre_data$npx, group_30plus_data$npx, paired = FALSE)
      protein_results$p_value_pre_vs_30plus <- test_result$p.value
      protein_results$eff_size_pre_vs_30plus <- get_wilcox_effect_size(pre_data$npx, group_30plus_data$npx, paired = FALSE)
      protein_results$test_type_pre_30plus = "unpaired_wilcoxon"
      #  }
      
      # Test 3: 0-30 vs 30+ (unpaired - different subjects)
      if(nrow(group_0_30_data) >= 3 && nrow(group_30plus_data) >= 3) {
        #test_result <- t.test(group_0_30_data$npx, group_30plus_data$npx, paired = FALSE)
        test_result <- wilcox.test(group_0_30_data$npx, group_30plus_data$npx, paired = FALSE)
        protein_results$p_value_0_30_vs_30plus <- test_result$p.value
        protein_results$eff_size_0_30_vs_30plus <- get_wilcox_effect_size(group_0_30_data$npx, group_30plus_data$npx, paired = FALSE) #new
        protein_results$test_type_0_30_30plus = "unpaired_wilcoxon"
      }
      
      results_list[[protein]] <- protein_results
    }
    
    # Combine results
    all_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
    
    # Apply FDR correction to each p-value column
    all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_0_30 <- p.adjust(all_results$p_value_pre_vs_0_30, method = "fdr")
    all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_30plus <- p.adjust(all_results$p_value_pre_vs_30plus, method = "fdr")
    all_results$p_adj_0_30_vs_30plus <- p.adjust(all_results$p_value_0_30_vs_30plus, method = "fdr")
    
    # Add significance indicators
    all_results$sig_pre_vs_0_30 <- case_when(
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_0_30 < 0.001 ~ "***",
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_0_30 < 0.01 ~ "**",
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_0_30 < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
    
    all_results$sig_pre_vs_30plus <- case_when(
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_30plus < 0.001 ~ "***",
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_30plus < 0.01 ~ "**",
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_30plus < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
    
    all_results$sig_0_30_vs_30plus <- case_when(
      all_results$p_adj_0_30_vs_30plus < 0.001 ~ "***",
      all_results$p_adj_0_30_vs_30plus < 0.01 ~ "**",
      all_results$p_adj_0_30_vs_30plus < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
    
    return(all_results)
  }

create_plots_with_ggsignif_vi <- function(proteins_of_interest, data, statistical_results) {
  
  # You'll need: install.packages("ggsignif")
  library(ggsignif)
  
  plot_list <- lapply(proteins_of_interest, function(protein) {
    
    # Get statistical results for this protein
    protein_stats <- statistical_results %>% 
      filter(protein == !!protein)
    
    # Prepare plot data
    plot_data <- data %>% 
      filter(idnr %in% sminet_infected_subjects) %>%
      mutate(
        time_since_sminet = as.Date(sampling_time) - as.Date(sminet_date),
        time_since_sminet_group = case_when(
          time_since_sminet < 0 ~ "pre",
          time_since_sminet >= 0 & time_since_sminet <= 30 ~ "0-30",
          time_since_sminet > 30 ~ "30+"),
        vaccinated = case_when( Time_Sample_Dose1 <= 0 ~ "No",
                                T ~ "Yes"),
        time_since_sminet_group = factor(time_since_sminet_group, levels = c("pre", "0-30",  "30+"))
      ) %>%
      #filter(Time_Sample_Dose1 < 0) %>%
      #     filter( ! sampling_phase == "Phase 3") |>
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(proteins_of_interest), names_to = "assay", values_to = "npx") %>%
      #pivot_longer(cols = proteins_of_interest, names_to = "assay", values_to = "npx") %>%
      filter(assay == protein)
    
    # Prepare significance annotations with test info
    comparisons <- list()
    annotations <- c()
    
    if(!is.na(protein_stats$p_adj_pre_vs_0_30)) {
      comparisons <- append(comparisons, list(c("pre", "0-30")))
      annotations <- c(annotations, paste0(
        protein_stats$sig_pre_vs_0_30, "\n(", protein_stats$test_type_pre_0_30, ")"
      ))
    }
    
    if(!is.na(protein_stats$p_adj_pre_vs_30plus)) {
      comparisons <- append(comparisons, list(c("pre", "30+")))
      annotations <- c(annotations, paste0(
        protein_stats$sig_pre_vs_30plus, "\n(", protein_stats$test_type_pre_30plus, ")"
      ))
    }
    
    if(!is.na(protein_stats$p_adj_0_30_vs_30plus)) {
      comparisons <- append(comparisons, list(c("0-30", "30+")))
      annotations <- c(annotations, paste0(
        protein_stats$sig_0_30_vs_30plus, "\n(", protein_stats$test_type_0_30_30plus, ")"
      ))
    }
    
    p1 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = time_since_sminet_group, y = npx, group = idnr)) +
      geom_beeswarm(aes( my_col = time_since_sminet_group, my_x = time_since_sminet_group, my_shape = vaccinated))
    pb <- ggplot_build(p1)
    
    p <- ggplot(pb$data[[1]], aes(x = x, y = y, group = group)) +
      geom_line(aes(group = group), col = "grey80", alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_point( aes( color = my_col, shape = my_shape), size = 3, alpha = 0.6) +
      theme_classic() +
      scale_x_discrete() +
      labs(title = protein, y = "ProtPQN NPX [AU]", x = "Days since PCR+", subtitle = "Subjects with PCR+ confirmed infection and possibly vaccinated subjects") +
      geom_boxplot(aes(x = my_x, y = y, group = my_x), outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA) +
      scale_color_manual( values = c("grey", "red", "orange")) +
      guides(color="none")
    
    # Add significance brackets if we have comparisons
    if(length(comparisons) > 0) {
      p <- p + geom_signif(
        comparisons = comparisons,
        annotations = annotations,
        step_increase = 0.1,
        textsize = 2.5
      )
    }
    
    return(p)
  })
  
  names(plot_list) <- proteins_of_interest
  return(plot_list)
}

### Plot protein level for vaccinated and calculate significant using wilcox:
calculate_protein_stats_vaccine <- function(proteins_of_interest_tad, data) {
    
    results_list <- list()

    for(protein in proteins_of_interest_tad) {
      
      cat("Processing protein:", protein, "\n")
      
      # Prepare data for this protein
      protein_data <- data %>% 
        filter(!cluster_maximum_6prot_omi %in% c("2", "3")) |>
        mutate(
          time_since_vaccination_group = case_when(
            time_since_closest_date < 0 ~ "pre",
            time_since_closest_date >= 0 & time_since_closest_date <= 30 ~ "0-30",
            time_since_closest_date > 30 ~ "30+"
          ),
          time_since_vaccination_group = factor(time_since_vaccination_group, levels = c("pre", "0-30", "30+"))
        ) %>%
        pivot_longer(cols = all_of(proteins_of_interest), names_to = "assay", values_to = "npx") %>%
        filter(assay == protein)
      
      # Initialize results for this protein
      protein_results <- data.frame(
        protein = protein,
        p_value_pre_vs_0_30 = NA,
        eff_size_pre_vs_0_30 = NA,     # <-- Added
        p_value_pre_vs_30plus = NA,
        eff_size_pre_vs_30plus = NA,   # <-- Added
        p_value_0_30_vs_30plus = NA,
        eff_size_0_30_vs_30plus = NA,  # <-- Added
        n_pre = 0,
        n_0_30 = 0,
        n_30plus = 0,
        n_paired_pre_0_30 = 0,
        n_paired_pre_30plus = 0,
        test_type_pre_0_30 = NA,
        test_type_pre_30plus = NA,
        test_type_0_30_30plus = NA
      )
      
      # Count samples in each group
      protein_results$n_pre <- sum(protein_data$time_since_vaccination_group == "pre", na.rm = TRUE)
      protein_results$n_0_30 <- sum(protein_data$time_since_vaccination_group == "0-30", na.rm = TRUE)
      protein_results$n_30plus <- sum(protein_data$time_since_vaccination_group == "30+", na.rm = TRUE)
      
      # Test 1: pre vs 0-30 (paired if same subjects exist in both groups)
      pre_data <- protein_data %>% filter(time_since_vaccination_group == "pre")
      group_0_30_data <- protein_data %>% filter(time_since_vaccination_group == "0-30")
      
      # Find subjects present in both pre and 0-30 groups
      paired_subjects_pre_0_30 <- intersect(pre_data$idnr, group_0_30_data$idnr)
      protein_results$n_paired_pre_0_30 <- length(paired_subjects_pre_0_30)
      
      if(length(paired_subjects_pre_0_30) >= 5) {  # Minimum 5 pairs for meaningful paired test
        # Paired t-test
        pre_paired <- pre_data %>% filter(idnr %in% paired_subjects_pre_0_30) %>% arrange(idnr)
        group_0_30_paired <- group_0_30_data %>% filter(idnr %in% paired_subjects_pre_0_30) %>% arrange(idnr)
        
        if(nrow(pre_paired) == nrow(group_0_30_paired)) {
          #test_result <- t.test(pre_paired$npx, group_0_30_paired$npx, paired = TRUE)
          test_result <- wilcox.test(pre_paired$npx, group_0_30_paired$npx, paired = TRUE)
          protein_results$p_value_pre_vs_0_30 <- test_result$p.value
          protein_results$eff_size_pre_vs_0_30 <- get_wilcox_effect_size(pre_paired$npx, group_0_30_paired$npx, paired = TRUE) #new
          protein_results$test_type_pre_0_30 = "paired_wilcoxon"
        }
      } else if(nrow(pre_data) >= 3 && nrow(group_0_30_data) >= 3) {
        # Unpaired t-test if not enough pairs
        #test_result <- t.test(pre_data$npx, group_0_30_data$npx, paired = FALSE)
        test_result <- wilcox.test(pre_data$npx, group_0_30_data$npx, paired = FALSE)
        protein_results$p_value_pre_vs_0_30 <- test_result$p.value
        protein_results$eff_size_pre_vs_0_30 <- get_wilcox_effect_size(pre_data$npx, group_0_30_data$npx, paired = FALSE) #new
        protein_results$test_type_pre_0_30 = "unpaired_wilcoxon"
      }
      
      # Test 2: pre vs 30+ (paired if same subjects exist in both groups)
      group_30plus_data <- protein_data %>% filter(time_since_vaccination_group == "30+")
      
      # Find subjects present in both pre and 30+ groups
      paired_subjects_pre_30plus <- intersect(pre_data$idnr, group_30plus_data$idnr)
      protein_results$n_paired_pre_30plus <- length(paired_subjects_pre_30plus)
      
      if(length(paired_subjects_pre_30plus) >= 5) {  # Minimum 5 pairs for meaningful paired test
        # Paired t-test
        pre_paired <- pre_data %>% filter(idnr %in% paired_subjects_pre_30plus) %>% arrange(idnr)
        group_30plus_paired <- group_30plus_data %>% filter(idnr %in% paired_subjects_pre_30plus) %>% arrange(idnr)
        
        if(nrow(pre_paired) == nrow(group_30plus_paired)) {
          test_result <- wilcox.test(pre_paired$npx, group_30plus_paired$npx, paired = TRUE)
          protein_results$p_value_pre_vs_30plus <- test_result$p.value
          protein_results$eff_size_pre_vs_30plus <- get_wilcox_effect_size(pre_paired$npx, group_30plus_paired$npx, paired = TRUE) #new
          protein_results$test_type_pre_30plus = "paired_wilcoxon"
          
        } else { #(nrow(pre_data) >= 3 && nrow(group_30plus_data) >= 3) {
          test_result <- wilcox.test(pre_data$npx, group_30plus_data$npx, paired = FALSE)
          protein_results$p_value_pre_vs_30plus <- test_result$p.value
          protein_results$eff_size_pre_vs_30plus <- get_wilcox_effect_size(pre_data$npx, group_30plus_data$npx, paired = FALSE)
          protein_results$test_type_pre_30plus = "unpaired_wilcoxon"
          
          
        }
      }
      
      # Test 3: 0-30 vs 30+ (unpaired - different subjects)
      if(nrow(group_0_30_data) >= 3 && nrow(group_30plus_data) >= 3) {
        #test_result <- t.test(group_0_30_data$npx, group_30plus_data$npx, paired = FALSE)
        test_result <- wilcox.test(group_0_30_data$npx, group_30plus_data$npx, paired = FALSE)
        protein_results$p_value_0_30_vs_30plus <- test_result$p.value
        protein_results$eff_size_0_30_vs_30plus <- get_wilcox_effect_size(group_0_30_data$npx, group_30plus_data$npx, paired = FALSE) #new
        protein_results$test_type_0_30_30plus = "unpaired_wilcoxon"
      }
      
      results_list[[protein]] <- protein_results
    }
    
    # Combine results
    all_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
    
    # Apply FDR correction to each p-value column
    all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_0_30 <- p.adjust(all_results$p_value_pre_vs_0_30, method = "fdr")
    all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_30plus <- p.adjust(all_results$p_value_pre_vs_30plus, method = "fdr")
    all_results$p_adj_0_30_vs_30plus <- p.adjust(all_results$p_value_0_30_vs_30plus, method = "fdr")
    
    # Add significance indicators
    all_results$sig_pre_vs_0_30 <- case_when(
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_0_30 < 0.001 ~ "***",
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_0_30 < 0.01 ~ "**",
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_0_30 < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
    
    all_results$sig_pre_vs_30plus <- case_when(
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_30plus < 0.001 ~ "***",
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_30plus < 0.01 ~ "**",
      all_results$p_adj_pre_vs_30plus < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
    
    all_results$sig_0_30_vs_30plus <- case_when(
      all_results$p_adj_0_30_vs_30plus < 0.001 ~ "***",
      all_results$p_adj_0_30_vs_30plus < 0.01 ~ "**",
      all_results$p_adj_0_30_vs_30plus < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
    
    return(all_results)
  }

  library(ggsignif)
  
  plot_list <- lapply(proteins_of_interest, function(protein) {

      filter(protein == !!protein)
    
    # Prepare plot data
```
