```{r}
      filter(!cluster_maximum_6prot_omi %in% c("2", "3")) |>
      mutate(
        # time_since_sminet = as.Date(sampling_time) - as.Date(sminet_date),
        time_since_vaccination_group = case_when(
          time_since_closest_date < 0 ~ "pre",
          time_since_closest_date >= 0 & time_since_closest_date <= 30 ~ "0-30",
          time_since_closest_date > 30 ~ "30+"
        ),
        time_since_vaccination_group = factor(time_since_vaccination_group, levels = c("pre", "0-30", "30+"))
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(proteins_of_interest), names_to = "assay", values_to = "npx") %>%
      filter(assay == protein)
    
    # Prepare significance annotations with test info
    comparisons <- list()
    annotations <- c()
    
    if(!is.na(protein_stats$p_adj_pre_vs_0_30)) {
      comparisons <- append(comparisons, list(c("pre", "0-30")))
      annotations <- c(annotations, paste0(
        protein_stats$sig_pre_vs_0_30, "\n(", protein_stats$test_type_pre_0_30, ")"
      ))
    }
    
    if(!is.na(protein_stats$p_adj_pre_vs_30plus)) {
      comparisons <- append(comparisons, list(c("pre", "30+")))
      annotations <- c(annotations, paste0(
        protein_stats$sig_pre_vs_30plus, "\n(", protein_stats$test_type_pre_30plus, ")"
      ))
    }
    
    if(!is.na(protein_stats$p_adj_0_30_vs_30plus)) {
      comparisons <- append(comparisons, list(c("0-30", "30+")))
      annotations <- c(annotations, paste0(
        protein_stats$sig_0_30_vs_30plus, "\n(", protein_stats$test_type_0_30_30plus, ")"
      ))
    }
    
    # 
    ## Create plot with lines between same subject:
    p1 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = time_since_vaccination_group, y = npx, group = idnr)) +
      geom_beeswarm(aes( my_col = time_since_vaccination_group, my_x = time_since_vaccination_group))
    pb <- ggplot_build(p1)
    
    p <- ggplot(pb$data[[1]], aes(x = x, y = y, group = group)) +
      geom_line(aes(group = group), col = "grey80", alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_point( aes( color = my_col), size = 3, alpha = 0.6) +
      theme_classic() +
      scale_x_discrete() +
      labs(title = protein, y = "ProtPQN NPX [AU]", x = "Days since closest vaccination", subtitle = "Excluding samples in serocluster 2 and 3 (infected)") +
      geom_boxplot(aes(x = my_x, y = y, group = my_x), outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA) +
      scale_color_manual( values = c("grey", "red", "orange")) +
      guides(color="none")
    
    
    
    # Add significance brackets if we have comparisons
    if(length(comparisons) > 0) {
      p <- p + geom_signif(
        comparisons = comparisons,
        annotations = annotations,
        step_increase = 0.1,
        textsize = 2.5
      )
    }
    
    return(p)
  })
  
  names(plot_list) <- proteins_of_interest
  return(plot_list)
}

  left_join(
    olink_bamse_protpqn_blank_rm_intnorm_si %>%
      select(
        samplename, idnr, sampling_phase, sminet_case, sminet_date,
        sampling_time, date1, date2, date3
      ),
    by = "samplename"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sampling_time = as.Date(sampling_time),
    dose1_date = as.Date(date1),
    dose2_date = as.Date(date2),
    dose3_date = as.Date(date3)
  )

# select pre- and post-vaccine samples per subject
samples_pre_post <- time_adjusted_data_si_vaccination %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Collect dose dates (remove NA)
    dose_dates = list(na.omit(c(dose1_date, dose2_date, dose3_date))),
    # Compute min/max safely
    min_dose_date = if (length(dose_dates) > 0) min(dose_dates) else as.Date(NA),
    max_dose_date = if (length(dose_dates) > 0) max(dose_dates) else as.Date(NA),
    # Find the dose date closest in time (absolute difference)
    closest_dose_date = if (length(dose_dates) > 0) {
      dose_dates[which.min(abs(as.numeric(sampling_time - dose_dates)))]
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    # Compute time difference (can be negative if before vaccination)
    time_since_closest_date = as.numeric(sampling_time - closest_dose_date)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(idnr) %>%
  mutate(
    # Classify samples as pre- or post-vaccination
    type = case_when(
      !is.na(min_dose_date) & sampling_time < min_dose_date ~ "pre",
      !is.na(min_dose_date) & sampling_time >= min_dose_date ~ "post",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  # Keep latest pre and earliest post per person
  group_by(idnr, type) %>%
  filter(
    (type == "pre" & sampling_time == max(sampling_time)) |
      (type == "post" & sampling_time == min(sampling_time))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# check that we have max two per idnr
samples_pre_post %>%
  count(idnr) %>%
  count(n)
```

### Protein levels in Z-score over time (Figure 5d-g):

```{r}

### Z scores:
protein_since_infection_zscore <- function(proteins_of_interest, data) {
  
  plot_list <- lapply(proteins_of_interest, function(protein) {
    
    # Prepare plot data
    plot_data <- data %>% 
      filter(idnr %in% sminet_infected_subjects) %>%
      mutate(
        time_since_sminet = as.Date(sampling_time) - as.Date(sminet_date),
        time_since_sminet_group = case_when(
          time_since_sminet < 0 ~ "pre",
          time_since_sminet >= 0 & time_since_sminet <= 30 ~ "0-30",
          time_since_sminet > 30 ~ "30+"
        ),
        time_since_sminet_group = factor(time_since_sminet_group, levels = c("pre", "0-30",  "30+"))
      ) %>%
      filter(Time_Sample_Dose1 < 0) %>%
      #  filter( ! sampling_phase == "Phase 3") |>
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(proteins_of_interest), names_to = "assay", values_to = "z_score") %>%
      filter(assay == protein)
    
    plot_data <- plot_data |> 
      mutate(type = case_when(time_since_sminet < 0 ~ "pre",                                                        time_since_sminet > 0 ~ "post")) |>
      group_by(idnr, type) %>%
      filter(
        (type == "pre" & sampling_time == max(sampling_time)) |
          (type == "post" & sampling_time == min(sampling_time))
      ) %>%
      ungroup() |>
      # Make sure we only keep those idnr where we have one pre and one post sample:
      group_by(idnr) %>%
      filter(all(c("pre", "post") %in% type)) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    
    ymax <- max(abs(c(min(plot_data$z_score, na.rm=TRUE),
                      max(plot_data$z_score, na.rm=TRUE))))
    y_limits <- c(-ymax, ymax)
    
    p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = as.numeric(time_since_sminet), y = z_score, fill = z_score)) +
      geom_point(color = "black", shape = 21, size = 3 ) +
      #scale_fill_viridis(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "#09287d",
        mid = "white",
        high = "#7d0916",
        midpoint = 0,
        name = "Z-score"
      ) +
      #      scale_fill_steps2(high = "red", low = "blue", limits = c(-5, 5), midpoint = 0, breaks = c(-3, -2, 2, 3), labels = c("< -3", "-2", "2", ">3")) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_hline( yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotdash", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_hline( yintercept = 2, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_hline( yintercept = -2, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
      theme_classic() +
      labs(
        title = protein,
        subtitle = "Subjects with PCR+ confirmed infection, no vaccination",
        y = "Z score",
        x = "Days since PCR+"
      ) +
      guides(color = "none") +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10),
                         limits = y_limits) +
      theme(
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size=14))
    
    
    p1 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes( x = as.factor(1), y = z_score)) +
      #geom_boxplot(color = "black", size = 1, outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_quasirandom( aes(col = z_score), size = 2) +
      geom_boxplot(color = "black", size = 1, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0, width=0.2) +
      theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
            axis.text.x=element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x=element_blank()) +
      scale_color_gradient2(
        low = "#09287d",
        mid = "white",
        high = "#7d0916",
        midpoint = 0,
        name = "Z-score"
      )  +
      theme_classic() +
      #scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10),
                         limits = y_limits) +
      theme(
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size=14)
      )
    
    plot_comb <- p1 + p + plot_layout(guides = "collect", design = "
ABB")
    
    return(plot_comb)
    
  })
  names(plot_list) <- proteins_of_interest
  return(plot_list)
  
}

                      max(plot_data$z_score, na.rm=TRUE))))
    y_limits <- c(-ymax, ymax)
    
    
    p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = as.numeric(time_since_closest_date), y = z_score, fill = z_score)) +
      geom_point(color = "black", shape = 21, size = 3 ) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "#09287d",
        mid = "white",
        high = "#7d0916",
        midpoint = 0,
        name = "Z-score"
      )  +
      #scale_fill_steps2(high = "red", low = "blue", limits = c(-5, 5), midpoint = 0, breaks = c(-3, -2, 2, 3), labels = c("< -3", "-2", "2", ">3")) +
      #                 scale_fill_gradient2(
      #   low = "#4575B4",
      #   mid = "white",
      #   high = "#D73027",
      #   midpoint = 0,
      #   name = "Z-score"
      # )+
      #scale_fill_viridis(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_hline( yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotdash", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_hline( yintercept = 2, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_hline( yintercept = -2, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
      theme_classic() +
      labs(
        title = protein,
        subtitle = "Excluding samples in serocluster 2 and 3 (infected)",
        y = "Z-score",
        x = "Days since closest vaccination"
      ) +
      # guides(color = "none") +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10),
                         limits = y_limits) +
      theme(
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size=14))
    
    
    p1 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes( x = as.factor(1), y = z_score)) +
      #geom_boxplot(color = "black", size = 1, outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_quasirandom( aes(col = z_score), size = 2) +
      geom_boxplot(color = "black", size = 1, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0, width=0.2) +
      theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
            axis.text.x=element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x=element_blank()) +
      scale_color_gradient2(
        low = "#09287d",
        mid = "white",
        high = "#7d0916",
        midpoint = 0,
        name = "Z-score"
      )  +
      theme_classic() +
      #scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10),
                         limits = y_limits) +
      theme(
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        #axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size=14)
      )
    
    plot_comb <- p1 + p + plot_layout(guides = "collect", design = "
ABB")
    
    return(plot_comb)
    
    
    
  })
  names(plot_list) <- proteins_of_interest
  return(plot_list)
  
}

plots_zscores_V <- protein_since_vaccination_zcore(proteins_of_interest_tad, samples_pre_post)





plot_list <- lapply( 1:length(proteins_of_interest_tad), function( n){
  
  protein <- proteins_of_interest_tad[n]
  
  # Combine the z-score values across both datasets
  combined_z_limits <- range(
    time_adjusted_data_si_zscore[protein],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  # Optionally, extend slightly for nicer color distribution
  combined_z_limits[1] <- floor(combined_z_limits[1])
  combined_z_limits[2] <- ceiling(combined_z_limits[2])
  
  
  # Update the fill aesthetic mapping to use z_bin instead of z_score
  plots_zscores_I[[n]]$mapping$fill <- aes(fill = z_score)$fill
  plots_zscores_V[[n]]$mapping$fill <- aes(fill = z_score)$fill
  
  p_I <- plots_zscores_I[[n]]
  p_V <- plots_zscores_V[[n]]
  
  
  (wrap_plots(p_I) + wrap_plots(p_V)) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    scale_y_continuous(limits = combined_z_limits)
  
})
```

### Comparing proteins in relation to infection and vaccination (Fig. S19):

```{r}

# Comparing protein levels in previously infected versus seronegative subjects (Fig. S19a): 
#  COMPARE 11 and 22 at baseline:
n_runs <- 100
fdr_cutoff <- 0.05
seed_base <- 123

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(progress)

# Precompute group sizes
n12 <- time_adjusted_data_for_lm %>%
  filter(sampling_phase != "Phase 3", clust_traj12 == "22") %>%
  distinct(idnr) %>%
  nrow()

# Get random IDs in group 11
group11_ids <- time_adjusted_data_for_lm %>%
  filter(sampling_phase != "Phase 3", clust_traj12 == "11") %>%
  distinct(idnr) %>%
  pull(idnr)

# Function for bootstrap iteration
run_one_bootstrap_within_phase <- function(i) {
  set.seed(seed_base + i)
  
  # randomly sample n12 subjects from group11 (WITH replacement for bootstrap)
  sampled_11 <- sample(group11_ids, size = n12, replace = TRUE)
  
  # build data_list for analysis: keep group12 and the sampled group11 subjects
  data_subset <- time_adjusted_data_for_lm %>%
    filter(sampling_phase != "Phase 3") %>%
    filter(clust_traj12 == "22" | idnr %in% sampled_11)
  
  data_list <- list(
    values = data_subset %>%
      dplyr::select(sample_id, all_of(olink_proteins_ta)),     # adjust variable name if needed
    sinfo = data_subset %>%
      dplyr::select(idnr, sample_id, sampling_phase, clust_traj12, male)
  )
  
  # Run the delta-delta analysis (difference in change between Phase1 and Phase2 for each group)
  lm_dd <- lm_analysis(
    data_list,
    "sample_id",
    predictor = "clust_traj12",
    covar = "male",
    stratify_by = "sampling_phase"
    # difference_col = "sampling_phase",
    #  individual_id = "idnr",
    # differences_between = c("Phase 1", "Phase 2")
  )
  
  # lm_dd$results expected to be a data.frame with columns: assay, estimate, p_value, fdr
  res <- lm_dd$results %>%
    mutate(iter = i) %>%
    dplyr::select(assay, sampling_phase, median_diff, estimate, p_value, fdr, iter)
  
  # Return list of significant assays this run
  sig_assays_p1 <- res %>%filter(sampling_phase == "Phase 1") %>% filter(fdr < fdr_cutoff) %>% pull(assay)
  
  sig_assays_p2 <- res %>%filter(sampling_phase == "Phase 2") %>% filter(fdr < fdr_cutoff) %>% pull(assay)
  
  list(results = res, significant_p1 = sig_assays_p1, significant_p2 = sig_assays_p2)
}

# Run many iterations (serial)
pb <- progress_bar$new(total = n_runs)
all_iter_results <- vector("list", n_runs)
for (i in seq_len(n_runs)) {
  iter_out <- tryCatch({
    out <- run_one_bootstrap_within_phase(i)
    pb$tick()
    out
  }, error = function(e) {
    pb$tick()
    message("Error in iteration ", i, ": ", e$message)
    list(results = tibble(assay = character(), median_diff = numeric(), estimate = numeric(), p_value = numeric(), fdr = numeric(), iter = integer()),
         significant_p1 = character(0),
         significant_p2 = character(0))
  })
  all_iter_results[[i]] <- iter_out
}

# Aggregate outputs
# Frequency table: how many times each assay was significant
all_sig_lists_p1 <- map(all_iter_results, "significant_p1")
all_sig_flat_p1 <- unlist(all_sig_lists_p1)
protein_counts <- sort(table(all_sig_flat_p1), decreasing = TRUE)
protein_counts_p1_df <- tibble(
  assay = names(protein_counts),
  count = as.integer(protein_counts),
  freq = count / n_runs
)


all_sig_lists_p2 <- map(all_iter_results, "significant_p2")
all_sig_flat_p2 <- unlist(all_sig_lists_p2)
protein_counts <- sort(table(all_sig_flat_p2), decreasing = TRUE)
protein_counts_p2_df <- tibble(
  assay = names(protein_counts),
  count = as.integer(protein_counts),
  freq = count / n_runs
)

# Collect all per-iteration results (estimates, p-values)
all_results_df <- all_iter_results %>%
  map("results") %>%
  list_rbind()

# Compute summary statistics and 95% confidence intervals per assay
summary_df <- all_results_df %>%
  group_by(sampling_phase, assay) %>%
  summarise(
    median_median_diff = median( median_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_estimate = median(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_estimate = mean(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    lower_95 = quantile(estimate, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    upper_95 = quantile(estimate, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_pos = mean(estimate > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_neg = mean(estimate < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_sig = mean(fdr < fdr_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_non_na = sum(!is.na(estimate)),
    fdr_median = median(fdr),
    fdr_mean = mean(fdr),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(prop_sig), desc(prop_pos))

summary_df_1122 <- summary_df

### Plot Volcano plot:
volcano_1122_baseline <- ggplot(summary_df_1122, aes( x = median_median_diff, y = -log10(fdr_median))) +
  geom_point( aes( color = prop_sig, size = prop_sig)) +
  facet_wrap(~sampling_phase) +
  theme_classic() +
  #theme_bw() +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(summary_df_1122, prop_sig > 0.1),
    aes(label = str_remove(assay, "_Phase \\d")),  # Use the `protein` column as the label
    color = "black",
    box.padding = 0.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +

    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.0001, 1)),  # Grey for 0, then gradient starts
    limits = c(0, 1),
    name = "Proportion\nsignificant"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = round(seq(0, max(-log10(summary_df$fdr_median)+2), by = 1),1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Subjects who were infected in phase 2 vs naive",
    subtitle = "Bootstrapping naive group for 100 iterations",
    x = "Median difference between groups",
    y = "-log10(FDR)"
  ) +
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("sampling and vaccination dates_fig1b.csv")

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)

df_summarized <- df |> 
  # 1. Convert character strings to Date class
  mutate(across(c(sampling_time, date1, date2, date3), ymd)) |> 
  
  # 2. Invalidate doses that occurred AFTER sampling_time
  mutate(
    date1 = if_else(date1 <= sampling_time, date1, NA_Date_),
    date2 = if_else(date2 <= sampling_time, date2, NA_Date_),
    date3 = if_else(date3 <= sampling_time, date3, NA_Date_)
  ) |> 
  
  # 3. Pivot dose dates to long format to extract month/year
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(date1, date2, date3),
    names_to = "dose",
    values_to = "vax_date"
  ) |> 
  
  # 4. Keep valid vaccination dates and truncate to Year-Month (YYYY-MM-01)
  filter(!is.na(vax_date)) |> 
  mutate(date = floor_date(vax_date, unit = "month")) |> 
  
  # 5. Count samples per month per dose level
  count(date, dose) |> 
  
  # 6. Pivot back wide so each dose has its own column
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = dose,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |> 
  
  # 7. Rename columns and ensure date display format (YYYY-MM)
  rename(
    vaccine_dose_1 = date1,
    vaccine_dose_2 = date2,
    vaccine_dose_3 = date3
  ) |> 
  mutate(date = format(date, "%Y-%m")) |> 
  arrange(date)
```
